name: Unified Points, Beams, and Paths (UPBP)
definition: A combined rendering algorithm that fuses volumetric estimators (P-P, P-B, B-B) and their short-beam variants with unbiased path sampling techniques (BPT) using the extended balance heuristic.
summary: Unified Points, Beams, and Paths is a rendering algorithm that unifies biased photon mapping and unbiased path tracing to efficiently simulate light transport in participating media.
